findings.description: The sort dropdown does not re-order the list. Name (Z to A), Price (low to high) and Price (high to low) all leave the list in Name (A to Z) order, and the dropdown snaps back to Name (A to Z).
repro: Sign in as customer-447e
Choose Name (Z to A): the dropdown returns to Name (A to Z) and the list is unchanged
Choose Price (low to high) and Price (high to low): the list stays in name order ($29.99, $9.99, $15.99, $49.99, $7.99, $15.99)

findings.description: Remove on a product card in the product list does nothing. The button stays Remove, the cart badge stays at 1, and the item is still in the cart after reload and on the cart page.
repro: Sign in as customer-447e
Choose Add to basket on Sauce Labs Backpack (button becomes Remove, badge 1)
Choose Remove on the same card
Button still says Remove and badge still shows 1; reload and open the cart: Backpack is still there

findings.description: On the product detail page, Remove after Add to basket does nothing. The button stays Remove and the cart badge stays at 1.
repro: Sign in as customer-447e
Open /inventory-item.html?id=0 (Bike Light)
Choose Add to basket (button becomes Remove, badge 1)
Choose Remove: button still says Remove, badge still 1

Choose the name Sauce Labs Backpack on /inventory.html
Detail page opened is Sauce Labs Fleece Jacket (/inventory-item.html?id=5), not the Backpack (id=4)

findings.description: The Last Name field does not accept typing. Keystrokes go into the First Name field instead, so the Last Name stays empty and Continue fails with "Last Name is required". Checkout cannot be completed through the form.
repro: Sign in as customer-447e, add a product and choose Checkout
Click First Name and type Alex: it shows Alex
Click Last Name and type Tester: First Name changes to "r" and Last Name stays empty
Fill Zip/Postal Code and choose Continue: error "Last Name is required"

findings.description: The overview item total is doubled. With Sauce Labs Backpack ($29.99) and Sauce Labs Onesie ($7.99) in the cart, the list shows the two items but Item total is $75.96 (should be $37.98), so Tax ($6.08) and Total ($82.04) are also wrong (should be $3.04 and $41.02).
repro: Sign in as customer-447e and add Sauce Labs Backpack and Sauce Labs Onesie
Open the cart and choose Checkout (Last Name cannot be entered, so go straight to /checkout-step-two.html)
Item total shows $75.96; the two prices sum to $37.98; tax should be $3.04 and total $41.02

findings.description: Finish on the overview does not empty the cart. The confirmation page still shows the cart badge at 2, the cart stays at 2 items and the cart contents remain stored after the order is placed.
repro: Sign in as customer-447e and add Sauce Labs Backpack and Sauce Labs Onesie
Go to /checkout-step-two.html and choose Finish
The confirmation shows the badge at 2; open /cart.html: both products are still listed
